queries.server: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_setting('server_version') AS version,inet_server_addr()::text AS address,pg_is_in_recovery() AS recovery
queries.role: SELECT rolsuper,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user
queries.vector: SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector'
queries.schema: SELECT tablename,rowsecurity FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename LIKE 'business_concept%' ORDER BY tablename
queries.catalog: SELECT c.semantic_code,c.status,c.current_version,count(v.version) AS versions FROM business_concepts c JOIN business_concept_versions v ON c.id=v.concept_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.semantic_code
queries.identities: SELECT o.organization_code,w.slug,count(u.id) FILTER (WHERE u.status='active') AS active_users FROM core_organizations o JOIN core_workspaces w ON w.organization_id=o.id LEFT JOIN core_users u ON u.workspace_id=w.id GROUP BY o.organization_code,w.slug ORDER BY o.organization_code,w.slug
